output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minted, the balanceOf target address is increased without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be arbitrarily increased, resulting in a decrease in the balance of the owner.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] is increased, if _to is 0, the vulnerability is triggered, causing a decrease in the balanceOf[_from] without bound.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] is increased, if _to is 0, the vulnerability is triggered, causing a decrease in the balanceOf[_from] without bound.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the allowance mapping is updated, if the _value is large, it causes an overflow, allowing the allowance to be set to a large value.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_from] is decreased, if _value is large, it causes an overflow, allowing the burnFrom function to be called arbitrarily, draining funds.
